basis: The App Store privacy label for this app and the app's App Store description. Draft prepared 10 November 2026; awaiting the developer's confirmation.
summary: Volume Booster plays and boosts music and video on your device.

permissions.name: Apple Music / Media library

permissions.name: Photos
permissions.why: Only if you import audio or video from your photo library.

permissions.name: Bluetooth / AirPlay
permissions.why: To play through speakers, headphones and TVs you choose.

purchases: Premium is sold through the App Store. Apple handles payment.
